claims.claim: One page. Everything you own across a typical day, week, and month.
Start of day: check action items and SLA breach alerts — Dashboard → right panel → Action Items.
claims.finding: The Dashboard's Action Items panel was removed (Dashboard.tsx frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:1415).
claims.proposed_text: Review incoming faxes waiting for review: Fax Center → Fax Review Queue; watch the SLA column and the "SLA Breached" summary.

claims.claim: Review fax queue age (target: zero > 24 h): More (Fax) → Fax Review Queue.
claims.finding: The sidebar item is Fax Center (navigation.ts frontend/src/constants/navigation.ts:152); there is no More (Fax) item.
claims.proposed_text: Review incoming faxes waiting for review: Fax Center → Fax Review Queue; watch the SLA column and the "SLA Breached" summary.

claims.claim: Verify all providers are marked On Duty: Fleet Calendar → day view → provider swim lanes.
claims.finding: Fleet Calendar has no On Duty marker (no 'On Duty' in frontend/src/pages/ops).
claims.proposed_text: Check today's schedule by provider: Fleet Calendar → Day view → provider swim lanes.

claims.claim: Switch facility context: Header → facility name pill → select facility.
claims.finding: The header control is a Switch Facility button (AppShell.tsx frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx:1706).
claims.proposed_text: Switch facility: header → Switch Facility → search or pick a facility.

claims.claim: Tip: use ⌘K / Ctrl+K (Quick Jump) to navigate to any patient, visit, page, or facility without touching the sidebar.
claims.finding: Quick Jump searches pages, features and actions only (CommandBar.tsx frontend/src/components/app-shell/CommandBar.tsx:124).
claims.proposed_text: ⌘K / Ctrl+K (Quick Jump) goes to any page or feature: search pages, features or actions.

claims.claim: Daily: approve pending referral assignments — Referral Intake → Ready for Assignment column.

checks.pattern: // If moving to ASSIGNED, open assignment dialog

claims.claim: Daily: confirm no appointments on archived patients — Fleet Calendar → check for Archived patient badge.
claims.finding: Fleet Calendar shows no Archived badge; archived patients cannot be booked (AppointmentBookingModal.tsx frontend/src/components/AppointmentBookingModal.tsx:406).
claims.proposed_text: Troubleshooting: an archived patient still has an appointment — it was booked before the patient was archived (archived patients cannot be booked); cancel the appointment.

proposed_checks.pattern: setDateError("This patient is archived and cannot be scheduled");

claims.claim: Daily: review credential expirations due this week — HR & Compliance → Credential Tracker.
Daily: check for unanswered Team Chat pings — Team Chat → Conversations.
Daily: monitor IVR queue, flag any stalled requests — Inventory Management → IVR Tracking.
Keyboard shortcut ⌘K / Ctrl+K: Quick Jump — patient, visit, facility, page.
claims.finding: Quick Jump searches pages, features and actions only; CommandBar.tsx queries no patient table.
claims.proposed_text: ⌘K / Ctrl+K (Quick Jump) goes to any page or feature: search pages, features or actions.

claims.claim: Keyboard shortcut ⌘/ / Ctrl+/: help for the current page.
claims.finding: AppShell.tsx has no '/' key handler.
claims.proposed_text: (Remove: there is no ⌘/ shortcut.) ⌘K / Ctrl+K (Quick Jump) goes to any page or feature: search pages, features or actions.

claims.claim: Keyboard shortcut ⌘S / Ctrl+S: save draft on any editable form.
claims.finding: AppShell.tsx has no global 's' key handler; ⌘S works only in the billing Coding Review drawer.
claims.proposed_text: (Remove: there is no global ⌘S shortcut.)

claims.claim: SLA targets: zero faxes > 24 h; referral-to-schedule < 24 h from referral created; unbilled encounters cleared within 72 h of visit signature; unmatched ERAs reconciled within 24 h; credential expiry notices actioned same day.
Fax queue age: More (Fax) → Fax Review Queue → SLA Breach Timer column.
claims.finding: The column is SLA, with an SLA Breached summary (FaxReviewQueue.tsx frontend/src/components/idp/FaxReviewQueue.tsx:511).
claims.proposed_text: Review incoming faxes waiting for review: Fax Center → Fax Review Queue; watch the SLA column and the "SLA Breached" summary.

claims.claim: Referral-to-schedule time: Referral Intake → kanban → Ready for Assignment.

checks.note: exactly six column titles in the columns array

claims.claim: Unbilled encounters: Billing → Work Queue → Ready preset.
ERA posting: auto-posted; reconcile unmatched.

checks.pattern: so there is no manual "sync" action

claims.claim: ERA posting location: Billing → ERA / Payments (/era-eob).
claims.finding: The page is ERA / EOB (BillingDashboard.tsx frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:328); the /era-eob route is correct.
claims.proposed_text: ERA posting: matched lines post automatically; unmatched lines are matched on the ERA / EOB page (/era-eob), linked from the Billing overview.

proposed_checks.pattern: so there is no manual "sync" action

claims.claim: Credential expiry notices: HR & Compliance → Credential Tracker.
Weekly: run the Claims report (Billing → Reports Center → Claims Reports) and the Account Receivable report (Account Receivable Reports).
Weekly: scan the operational Heat Map (patients vs. clinicians) — Oversight Cockpit → Heat Map.
Weekly: audit inactive practices — CRM → Practices → filter by activity.
claims.finding: CRM has no activity filter; the status filter has Follow-up Due and Cold (Crm.tsx frontend/src/pages/Crm.tsx:4120).
claims.proposed_text: Review practices that need attention: CRM → status filter (Follow-up Due, Cold).

claims.claim: Weekly: verify inventory PAR levels are current — Inventory Management → Main Inventory.
claims.finding: Main Inventory opens Reorder Requests, which has no PAR levels; PAR levels show in the Product Catalog (Products.tsx frontend/src/pages/inventory-management/product-catalog/Products.tsx:631).
claims.proposed_text: Check PAR levels on conservative care products: Inventory Management → Product Catalog (red Par Level Reached icon).

proposed_checks.pattern: {/* Par Level - Only for Conservative, PRP and UM */}

claims.claim: Monthly: review revenue geography (Revenue by Zip) — Oversight Cockpit → Heat Map → Revenue by Zip.
claims.finding: The view is Billed by zip and plots dollars billed, not revenue received (heatMapDataService.ts frontend/src/services/heatMapDataService.ts:46).
claims.proposed_text: Scan the Heat Map (patients vs. clinicians): Oversight Cockpit → Heat Map → Patients vs Employees. Review billing geography: Heat Map → Billed by zip.

claims.claim: Monthly: export billing reports (Claims, Insurance Payment, Charges) — Billing → Reports Center.
Monthly: archive or close non-admit referrals — Referral Intake → Non-Admit column → Archive.
claims.finding: The card action is Archive patient, which archives the patient record, not the referral (Referrals.tsx frontend/src/pages/Referrals.tsx:467).
claims.proposed_text: Clear out patients who will not be admitted: Referral Intake → Non-Admit column → Archive patient on the card.

proposed_checks.pattern: // Archive (soft-delete): set `deleted_at` on the patient record.

claims.claim: Monthly: validate facility user roster is current — HR & Compliance → Facility Users.

checks.pattern: description: "View and manage all users associated with this facility.",

claims.claim: Onboarding: go to HR & Compliance → New Employee Onboarding; assign one or more facilities (multi-facility selection is supported); save to create the account.
Complete the single New Employee form (Basic Info; Provider Details appear for clinical roles). There is no multi-step wizard.
claims.finding: The single form is Create New User (HRNewUserPage.tsx frontend/src/pages/HRNewUserPage.tsx:2076) with sections such as Role & Assignment and Facility Assignment; there is no Basic Info or Provider Details section.
claims.proposed_text: HR & Compliance → New Employee Onboarding opens the Create New User form, a single page. Choose the role under Role & Assignment and one or more facilities under Facility Assignment, then click Create User.

claims.claim: Verify their permissions in Administrator → Organization Role Config; the matrix controls what each role can see across all modules.

checks.pattern: "Configure which features each role can access per organization. Organization admins only.",

claims.claim: Test a new role in the demo environment before applying it to production users.
claims.finding: Medipyxis offers customers no demo environment; nothing in pages/administrator mentions one.
claims.proposed_text: Check which features the role can open in Administrator → Organization Role Config. It turns features on or off for each role in your organization and does not assign roles to people.

proposed_checks.pattern: "Configure which features each role can access per organization. Organization admins only.",

claims.claim: The current facility context appears as a pill in the app header. Click the pill to open the facility selector; search by name or scroll.
claims.finding: The header control is a Switch Facility button with a Search facilities box (AppShell.tsx frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx:1756).
claims.proposed_text: Switch facility: header → Switch Facility → search or pick a facility.

claims.claim: All module data (patients, referrals, calendar, billing) scopes to the selected facility.
Practice admins with org-level access can toggle All Patients → All Facilities to view cross-facility patient lists without switching context.
Troubleshooting: provider not appearing in Fleet Calendar — provider not marked On Duty or facility mismatch; HR & Compliance → Facility Users — confirm facility assignment.
claims.finding: There is no On Duty marker in Fleet Calendar; the facility-assignment cause and fix are right.
claims.proposed_text: Troubleshooting: provider not appearing in Fleet Calendar — not assigned to this facility; confirm in HR & Compliance → Facility Users.

claims.claim: Troubleshooting: referral stuck in Info Needed — missing demographic or insurance field; open referral → Details tab → fill flagged field.
claims.finding: The referral drawer's Details tab does not flag missing fields (no 'flagged field' in UnifiedReferralDrawer.tsx).
claims.proposed_text: Troubleshooting: referral stuck in Info Needed — open the card → Details tab → complete the missing information, then drag the card on.

claims.claim: Troubleshooting: claim in Needs Info status — missing modifier or diagnosis pointer; Billing → Claims → open claim → follow rule-engine flag.
claims.finding: Needs Info means "Claim flagged for missing or incorrect information. Edit to fix." (BillingDashboard.tsx frontend/src/pages/BillingDashboard.tsx:1228); no 'rule-engine flag' is shown.
claims.proposed_text: Troubleshooting: claim in Needs Info status — a required field is missing or a validation error must be resolved; open the claim from Billing Operations → Claims and fix the field.

proposed_checks.pattern: "Claim flagged for missing or incorrect information. Edit to fix.",

claims.claim: Troubleshooting: credential expiry banner on Dashboard — credential nearing expiry; HR & Compliance → Credential Tracker → upload renewal.
claims.finding: The Dashboard has a My Credentials & Compliance tile, not an expiry banner (Dashboard.tsx frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:358).
claims.proposed_text: Check your credentials: Dashboard → My Credentials & Compliance. Credential expirations: HR & Compliance → Credential Tracker.
